sections.What we use it for:
Every project under `tooling/` targets `net10.0`. The SDK compiles them, runs the three test layers, and packs the CLI as a dotnet tool. It also runs `tooling/kac-tests.cs` as a file-based program that has no project around it.

`actions/setup-dotnet` installs `10.0.x` in every job of every workflow here.
sections.Licence and obligations: MIT. Nothing follows for a package this repository publishes.
sections.Where it is used:
* [svc-kac] is built, tested and packed with it.

The docs site and the marketplace branch are built by other toolchains, so neither uses it.
